items.title_en: Federal Reserve releases minutes of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting
items.title_zh: 美联储发布 7 月 28 至 29 日 FOMC 会议纪要
items.summary_en: The official minutes were released at 2:00 p.m. EDT on August 19. The underlying meeting kept the target range unchanged by a 9-3 vote, with three members preferring a quarter-point increase. This after-window archive makes no market-price or trade claim.
items.summary_zh: 官方会议纪要于 8 月 19 日美东时间下午 2 时发布。相关会议以 9 比 3 的表决维持目标利率区间不变，三名委员倾向加息 25 个基点。该窗口后归档不作市场价格或交易陈述。
items.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
